title: python: phantom 'lora_medium' import breaks schc/gateway/sim/tui test collection
description:
Pre-existing on main, introduced by commit 23a5572e83 (fix(python): misc protocol and interface fixes), NOT by any recent merge — found during 5r53 merge verification on heft (2026-09-09).

python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py:11 does 'from lora_medium import DutyCycleTracker' but no module lora_medium exists anywhere in-tree (python/src holds only 'lichen'; no pyproject dependency, no conftest sys.path setup, no file in git history ever). It presumably resolves only in the original author's venv via an out-of-tree checkout.

Blast radius (fresh host): python/tests/schc/test_ack.py, test_control_wire_issuance.py, test_fragment.py, test_reassembly.py (6 failures + 3 collection errors), python/tests/gateway/test_ble_lci.py, test_gcp6_vectors.py, test_gcp_iid_comparison_vectors.py + more, all of python/tests/tui (110 collection errors via tui/conftest.py), python/tests/sim duty-cycle tests. Partial-dir pytest runs abort on collection; full-suite runs lose these files entirely.

Fix options (owner's choice): (a) vendor the DutyCycleTracker (or split it into lichen.timing), (b) add the lora-medium package as a declared dependency, or (c) make the import optional/lazy with a skip marker — but tests that need it should xfail/skip explicitly, not error. Verify: python3 -m pytest python/tests/schc python/tests/gateway python/tests/tui collects cleanly and passes on a fresh checkout.
close_reason: False positive: lora-medium is a declared pinned git dependency (pyproject.toml since 11a3157934, 2026-07-31) predating the import (23a5572e83, 2026-08-26); collection+tests pass under project venv and uv run --frozen (1838 passed/4 skipped; sim duty-cycle 30 passed). No code change required; evidence in comments.
